summary:
Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in June 2018, based in Selangor, retailing textiles and baju kurung. Its latest recorded financials are for FY2024 (year-end 30 June 2024), audited unqualified by Audit Firm 8, consistent with FY2022 and FY2023.

FY2024 revenue was RM5.35m, up modestly from RM5.23m in FY2023, with gross margin improving to 35.1% from 29.0%. Profitability is thin: operating profit RM243,574 and profit after tax RM96,805 (net margin 1.81%), down from RM97,951 in FY2023. Interest coverage is 2.10x and debt service coverage 1.07x, with borrowings RM2.11m against total equity RM4.45m (leverage 0.81). Operating cash flow fell to RM113,617 and free cash flow was negative RM239,509 after RM353,126 capex. Receivables days are high at 87.6.

Ownership is concentrated: Director 4 holds 58.25%, Director 5 holds 21.22%, and all four shareholders are directors, so ownership and control overlap materially. The record lists no litigation cases.

Follow-up: obtain FY2025 financials, since the latest audited figures are now over a year stale relative to the 31 December 2025 snapshot.

Jaya Prima Travel Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company in Kuala Lumpur, incorporated 1 April 1995, operating as a travel agency for umrah and inbound tourism. Share capital is RM2,500,000.

The financial trajectory is the central due-diligence concern. Revenue fell from RM49.5m in FY2022 to RM46.5m in FY2023 and RM43.3m in FY2024 (year-end 31 December). Losses widened across the same period: profit after tax was -RM4.24m (FY2022), -RM6.12m (FY2023) and -RM7.52m (FY2024). Operating cash flow was negative in all three years, at -RM3.31m, -RM6.60m and -RM5.94m respectively, and free cash flow was -RM8.51m in FY2024. Equity halved from RM31.2m to RM17.6m between FY2022 and FY2024, while the leverage ratio rose from 1.29 to 2.56. Interest coverage was -8.13x in FY2024. Net working capital turned negative (-RM4.23m) in FY2024, and the quick ratio fell to 0.55. Audits were unqualified in all three years.

Ownership is concentrated: Director 1 holds 47.38%, Director 2 34.78% and Director 4 17.84%, so all shareholders are also directors. Director 2 was appointed 27 October 2025, after the latest financial year.

The record lists no litigation cases.

Follow-up: obtain FY2025 management accounts and evidence of shareholder support or refinancing, given persistent losses, negative operating cash flow and rising leverage.

Indah Prima Medical Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in April 1993, operating in Kelantan in community pharmacy and health supplements. Its latest recorded financials are for FY2024 (year-end 30 September 2024), audited unqualified by Audit Firm 5, consistent with FY2022 and FY2023.

The financial trend is the main due-diligence concern. Revenue fell from RM5.53m in FY2022 to RM4.84m in FY2024, while operating losses widened from RM455,511 to RM1,027,496 and net loss from RM516,132 to RM1,080,511. Gross margin improved to 48.4% in FY2024, but the operating expense ratio rose to 69.7%, so the business is not covering overheads. Operating cash flow was negative RM818,980 in FY2024, with free cash flow of negative RM1,131,822. Equity fell from RM3.78m to RM1.88m over the period, and leverage rose to 2.62x. Liquidity is tight: quick ratio 0.60 and net working capital negative RM448,041.

Ownership is concentrated: Director 4 holds 75.61% and is also a director; Director 5 holds 13.5%, Director 3 10.25% and Director 1 0.64%, all with board roles. The record lists no litigation cases.

Follow-up: request FY2025 management accounts and an explanation of the cost base driving widening operating losses.

**Teguh Kirana Freight Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000165) is an active private limited company incorporated in September 1992, registered in Pulau Pinang, with a stated nature of business of last-mile parcel delivery across Kuching. Paid-up share capital is RM2,500,000. The board has five directors, including one independent director; the longest-serving was appointed in 2001.

Ownership is highly concentrated: Director 5 holds 98.34% and Director 4 holds 1.66%, so both shareholders sit on the board. This overlap and the absence of any non-director shareholder are material governance points for counterparty review.

Financials are available to FY2024 (year-end 31 March 2024), all with unqualified opinions from Audit Firm 5. Revenue grew from RM10.87m in FY2022 to RM21.52m in FY2024, with profit after tax rising from RM431k to RM914k. However, net margin was thin at 4.25% in FY2024, and leverage rose sharply: the leverage ratio moved from 0.53 in FY2022 to 1.62 in FY2024, with total liabilities of RM13.39m against equity of RM8.28m. Net working capital turned negative (RM64k) in FY2024, and the quick ratio fell to 0.99. Interest coverage remained adequate at 8.41x.

The record lists one litigation case: a debt-recovery claim of RM169,800 filed in 2024 in which the company was plaintiff, now settled.

**Follow-up:** Request the FY2025 audited accounts to establish whether the rising leverage and negative working capital position have continued.

**Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000217) is an active private limited company incorporated in December 1991, registered in Selangor. Its stated business is private kindergarten and childcare (tadika and taska) in Johor Bahru — a mismatch with the Selangor registered state worth clarifying.

**Financials (FY2024, year-end 31 Dec 2024):** Revenue RM5.61m, gross profit RM3.03m (54.1% margin), operating profit RM654k, profit after tax RM386k. Operating cash flow RM524k and free cash flow RM358k were positive. Borrowings rose to RM2.65m from RM1.94m in FY2023, lifting leverage to 2.65x; interest coverage was 4.48x and debt service coverage 1.51x. The quick ratio fell to 0.96 and net working capital turned negative (RM87k). FY2023 revenue was RM4.10m with PAT of RM226k.

**Governance and audit:** Ownership is concentrated between two directors — Director 1 holds 51.02% and Director 2 holds 48.98%, so full director-shareholder overlap exists. The FY2023 accounts carry a **disclaimer of opinion** from Audit Firm 3, while FY2022 and FY2024 were unqualified. The record lists no litigation cases.

**Follow-up:** Obtain the basis for the FY2023 disclaimer and evidence that the underlying issues were resolved before relying on the FY2024 unqualified opinion.

**Global Everbright Store Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000267) is an active Kuala Lumpur private limited company, incorporated 28 October 1990, retailing textiles and baju kurung. It changed its name from Sinar Industries Sdn. Bhd. on 25 June 2025. Share capital is RM500,000.

**Financials (FY2024, year-end 30 June 2024):** Revenue RM19.37m, gross profit RM6.11m (31.5% margin), operating profit RM947,878, profit after tax RM473,200 (2.4% net margin). Cash RM3.04m; total borrowings RM5.91m; total equity RM12.32m. Operating cash flow RM965,505, but free cash flow was negative RM189,074 after RM1.15m capex. Interest coverage 2.91x and debt service coverage 1.37x are moderate. FY2023 comparatives: revenue RM18.06m, PAT RM406,159, free cash flow negative RM322,553. Audit opinions were unqualified in FY2022–FY2024 (Audit Firm 2).

**Governance:** Ownership is concentrated — Director 1 holds 89.67% and Director 2 holds 10.33%, so both directors are also shareholders. Director 1 was appointed 5 January 2024, relatively recently.

**Litigation:** The record lists five cases, all as plaintiff. One remains pending: CASE-2024-5974 (breach of contract, Sessions Court, filed 11 March 2024, RM177,000 claimed). Others are settled, dismissed or withdrawn; a settled RM2.26m High Court claim (CASE-2025-4060) is noted, but no settlement terms are given.

**Follow-up:** Request the FY2025 audited accounts, since the latest financials are now over a year stale relative to the 31 December 2025 snapshot.

Delima Pacific Academy Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in June 1991, based in Kuala Lumpur, providing professional training courses in accounting and finance. The record lists no litigation cases.

Financially, the latest available year is FY2024 (year-end 31 March 2024), with an unqualified audit opinion from Audit Firm 4, consistent with FY2022 and FY2023. Revenue rose from RM25.10m (FY2022) to RM27.55m (FY2024), while profit after tax grew from RM1.39m to RM1.87m; net margin improved from 5.55% to 6.77%. Operating cash flow was RM3.79m in FY2024, with free cash flow of RM2.03m. Interest coverage was 7.92x and the quick ratio 1.80, though cash fell to RM1.44m from RM1.75m in FY2022. Receivables are notable at RM7.03m, with days sales outstanding at 93.1 days.

Governance is concentrated: two directors hold all shares (57.42% and 42.58%), so director-shareholder overlap is complete. Financials stop at FY2024, leaving a gap to the 31 December 2025 snapshot.

Follow-up: obtain FY2025 audited accounts to confirm whether revenue, margins and cash flow trends have held.

**Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd.** is an active Sabah-based private limited company (incorporated 20 November 2017) whose recorded business is wholesale distribution of frozen food to restaurants. Paid-up share capital is RM500,000.

**Ownership and governance.** Ownership is highly concentrated: Director 1 holds 98.86% and Director 2 holds 1.14%, so both shareholders are also directors — a director-shareholder overlap. A third, independent director was appointed only in December 2024.

**Financials.** FY2024 (year-end 31 December 2024) revenue was RM4.42m, up modestly from RM4.21m in FY2022. Gross margin held near 50% (50.3% vs 49.8%), but net margin slipped to 4.05% from 4.12%, and operating cash flow fell to RM220,184 from RM434,476. Free cash flow turned negative at –RM20,288 (FY2022: RM171,072). Leverage eased to 1.45x (FY2022: 1.68x), interest coverage was 3.01x, and the cash conversion cycle was 137 days. Both years carry unqualified audit opinions from Audit Firm 8.

**Litigation.** The record lists six cases, all as defendant. Unresolved: a 2022 High Court winding-up petition (RM355,900) and a 2022 tenancy dispute (RM110,600). A 2024 debt-recovery case (RM97,600) has judgment entered; two matters settled and one was dismissed.

**Follow-up:** Obtain the current status and any payment position on the pending winding-up petition (CASE-2022-9003) before proceeding.

**Global Pacific Perunding Sdn. Bhd.** is an active private limited company incorporated on 15 January 2014, based in Perak. It provides management consulting for SMEs and is classified under professional services. Its share capital is RM500,000, and the record lists no former names.

For due diligence, the key facts are governance-related. Ownership is concentrated: Director 2 holds 58.7%, Director 3 holds 29.76% and Director 1 holds 11.54%. All three shareholders are also directors, so ownership and management overlap entirely. Director 2's 58.7% stake gives that individual majority control, and Director 2 was appointed only on 1 May 2024, relatively recently. Director 1 (Managing Director) and Director 3 (Executive Director) have served since 2021 and 2018 respectively.

The record contains no financial statements for any year, so revenue, profitability, liquidity and net worth cannot be assessed; this is a material evidence gap rather than a finding of weakness. The litigation section lists no cases, so no pending or concluded claims are recorded.

The most important follow-up is to obtain audited or management financial statements, particularly covering the period since Director 2's 2024 appointment, to test whether the majority-owner transition coincided with any change in performance or related-party dealings.

**Gemilang Harmoni Enterprise Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000333) is an active private limited company in Sarawak, incorporated on 21 October 1997, retailing textiles and baju kurung. It was formerly named Unity Industries Sdn. Bhd. until 3 September 2025, so older records and counterparties may refer to it under that name. Share capital is RM5,000,000.

The ownership structure is fully concentrated among the three directors, who together hold 100%: Director 2 holds 45.57%, Director 3 holds 29.41% and Director 1 holds 25.02%. This director-shareholder overlap means control and ownership sit with the same small group, with no external or corporate shareholder disclosed. Director 1 has served as Managing Director since April 2014; Director 3 since August 2010; Director 2 was appointed in January 2023.

The record contains no financial statements for any year, so revenue, profitability, liquidity and leverage cannot be assessed, and there is no basis to judge whether the RM5,000,000 share capital is paid up or reflected in current net assets. The litigation list is empty, so no cases are recorded.

The key evidence gap is the complete absence of financials. A specific follow-up: request the latest audited or management accounts, plus confirmation of paid-up capital, before any closer look.

Cahaya Harmoni Hotel Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000381) is an active private limited company incorporated in October 1995, recorded in hospitality with a stated nature of business as a boutique hotel in Kota Kinabalu. Its registered state is Kedah, which sits oddly against the Sabah operating location and is worth clarifying. Paid-up share capital is RM1,000,000.

Ownership is concentrated: Gemilang Holdings Sdn. Bhd. holds 51.0%, with Director 1 at 24.89% and Director 2 at 24.11% — the two directors together hold a majority alongside the corporate shareholder, so director-shareholder overlap is material. Both directors have long tenure (appointed 1996 and 1999).

FY2024 (year-end 31 December 2024) shows revenue of RM16.44m, operating profit RM1.61m, profit after tax RM975,406 and EBITDA RM2.11m (12.86% margin). Revenue rose from RM12.04m in FY2023, but net margin slipped from 7.10% to 5.93%. Leverage rose to 1.6492 and borrowings to RM5.99m; interest coverage was 4.90x and debt service coverage 2.29x. Cash conversion cycle was 130 days, with receivables at 80 days. All three years carry unqualified opinions from Audit Firm 6. The record lists no litigation cases.

Follow-up: obtain FY2025 management accounts and confirm the actual operating location and licensing, given the Kedah-versus-Kota Kinabalu discrepancy.

**Pacific Pacific Education Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000397) is an active private limited company incorporated 11 May 2006 in Selangor, operating a tuition centre for primary and secondary students. Share capital is RM2,500,000.

Ownership is concentrated and overlaps with management: Director 1 (Managing Director) holds 49.67%, Director 4 (Executive Director) 33.46%, Director 2 14.89% and Director 3 1.98% — all four shareholders sit on the board. FY2024 (year-end 31 December 2024) revenue was RM6,863,227, up from RM6,451,187 in FY2022, but profit after tax fell to RM371,117 from RM418,310; net margin narrowed to 5.41% from 6.48%. EBITDA was RM970,811 (14.15% margin). Interest coverage was 6.81x (FY2022: 7.97x) and debt service coverage 2.54x (FY2022: 2.96x). Quick ratio improved to 2.55, though receivables days remain high at 98.6. Both years carry unqualified opinions from Audit Firm 2.

Litigation is a material gap: six defendant-side cases. A RM7,427,000 debt-recovery claim (filed November 2025) is recorded as settled; two claims remain pending — RM320,300 (tenancy) and RM458,400 (breach of contract) — and two judgments have been entered (RM58,600 and RM721,100).

Follow-up: obtain the settlement terms and payment status of CASE-2025-5402, and confirm provisions for the two pending claims.

Mutiara Delima Bakery Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000451) is an active Kuala Lumpur-incorporated private limited company in food and beverage, operating coffee shops and cafés in Penang. It was incorporated in 1995 and changed its name from Gemilang Ventures Sdn. Bhd. on 27 November 2025. Issued share capital is RM500,000.

Financials are audited unqualified by Audit Firm 4, but the latest available year is FY2024 (year-end 30 June 2024), so the record is stale relative to the 31 December 2025 snapshot. FY2024 revenue was RM2.08m, down from RM2.25m in FY2023, with a net loss of RM275,562 (FY2023: RM267,235 loss). Losses have persisted across FY2022–FY2024. Equity turned negative at -RM18,522 in FY2024, and the leverage ratio is -106.56; interest coverage is -5.37x. Operating cash flow was -RM138,894 and free cash flow -RM205,752. Liquidity is tight: quick ratio 0.63 and net working capital -RM17,735.

Ownership is concentrated: four individual shareholders, all directors, hold 50.59%, 25.88%, 13.39% and 10.14% — full director-shareholder overlap. Litigation lists a dismissed RM106,900 debt-recovery claim against the company (2025) and a settled RM519,800 claim it brought (2021).

Follow-up: obtain FY2025 audited accounts to establish whether the negative equity and cash burn persisted.

Kirana Everbright Packaging Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000476) is an active private limited company incorporated in November 2005, based in Sarawak, and manufactures plastic packaging for food products. It is wholly owned by Sejahtera Holdings Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-009086), a Malaysian company — a concentrated ownership structure. Four directors are recorded, including a Managing Director appointed in 2017 and a director appointed in November 2024; the record does not show whether any director also holds shares, since the sole shareholder is corporate.

Financials are available for FY2022, FY2023 and FY2024, all with unqualified opinions from Audit Firm 8. The trend is the main due-diligence concern: revenue fell from RM37.58m (FY2022) to RM30.35m (FY2023) and RM24.21m (FY2024), while net profit after tax dropped from RM2.23m to RM1.01m to RM0.27m. FY2024 operating margin was 2.29% and net margin 1.11%. Interest coverage weakened from 10.43x (FY2022) to 2.76x (FY2024), and debt service coverage fell to 1.56x. Liquidity remains adequate (quick ratio 1.57; cash RM2.05m at FY2024). The record lists no litigation cases.

Follow-up: obtain an explanation for the three-year revenue and margin decline and confirm FY2025 trading performance, since the latest audited figures are FY2024.

**Seri Jaya Store Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000510) is an active private limited company incorporated 30 November 2006, registered in Kuala Lumpur but retailing mobile phones and accessories in Kuantan. Paid-up share capital is RM100,000.

**Financial trend (FY2022–FY2024, all unqualified opinions from Audit Firm 5):** Revenue fell from RM6.60m (FY2022) to RM5.52m (FY2023) and RM4.37m (FY2024). Net profit after tax compressed sharply over the same period: RM229,381 → RM113,006 → RM35,641, with net margin down from 3.48% to 0.82%. EBITDA fell from RM729,726 to RM330,252. Interest coverage weakened from 8.23x to 2.70x, and FY2024 free cash flow turned negative at –RM50,142 despite positive operating cash flow of RM166,918. Liquidity remains comfortable (quick ratio 3.95x; cash ratio 1.36x), and leverage is low (0.14). The cash conversion cycle is long at roughly 112 days, driven by receivables and inventory.

**Governance:** Ownership is highly concentrated — Director 2 holds 96.87% and Director 1 holds 3.13%, so both shareholders are also directors. Director 2 was appointed only on 14 August 2025, after the latest financial year.

**Litigation:** The record lists no cases.

**Follow-up:** Request FY2025 management accounts to establish whether the revenue and margin decline continued after the August 2025 board change.

Sinar Everbright Trading Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in December 2007, based in Kuala Lumpur, operating online retail of baby products and toys. The record lists no litigation cases.

Financially, the trajectory is the main due-diligence concern. Revenue fell from RM1.67m in FY2022 to RM1.41m in FY2023 and RM1.12m in FY2024 (year-end 31 December). Profit after tax compressed sharply over the same period: RM45,104 (FY2022), RM21,172 (FY2023) and RM3,710 (FY2024), with the FY2024 net margin at just 0.33%. Interest coverage weakened from 3.83x to 1.35x, and debt service coverage fell to 1.04x, leaving little headroom. Positives include unqualified audit opinions across all three years, improving quick ratio (1.39 in FY2024), and reduced leverage (0.33). Free cash flow was negative RM34,197 in FY2024.

Governance is concentrated: Director 3 holds 72.7%, with three other directors holding the remainder—substantial director-shareholder overlap. Financials stop at FY2024, so FY2025 performance is an evidence gap.

Follow-up: request FY2025 management accounts and confirm whether the FY2024 profit and coverage decline has continued.

**Cahaya Golden Systems Sdn. Bhd.** is a Selangor-based private limited company incorporated in September 2019, developing small-business accounting software. Its recorded status is **winding up** — the single most important fact for any counterparty review.

Financials are only available to FY2024 (year-end 31 March 2024), so they predate the current status and are stale. FY2024 revenue was RM13.01m (FY2023: RM12.69m), with profit after tax of RM1.28m (FY2023: RM1.14m) and a 9.8% net margin. Operating cash flow fell to RM1.33m from RM1.88m, and free cash flow to RM0.61m from RM1.33m. Leverage improved to 0.60 and interest coverage was 8.03x. FY2022 carried an unqualified opinion with a material going-concern uncertainty; FY2023 and FY2024 were unqualified.

Ownership is concentrated: Director 2 holds 52.17%, Director 1 32.4% and Director 3 15.43% — all three are also directors, so ownership and control overlap fully.

Litigation is heavy and all as defendant. Pending: a RM690,500 debt-recovery claim (Sessions Court), breach-of-contract claims of RM1,165,200 (High Court), RM606,600 and RM40,100. A RM3,840,700 winding-up petition was withdrawn; a RM10,000 petition reached judgment; one contract case was dismissed and one settled.

**Follow-up:** Obtain the winding-up order and current liquidator status, and confirm whether the pending claims are being pursued.

Gemilang Mega Systems Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000546) is an active private limited company incorporated on 14 December 1994 in Pulau Pinang, developing software for small business accounting. Two individual shareholders hold the entire equity: Director 1 (Managing Director, appointed 2007) at 55.65% and Director 2 (Director, appointed 2003) at 44.35% — full director-shareholder overlap and concentrated ownership.

Financials are available to FY2024 (year-end 31 March 2024), audited unqualified by Audit Firm 5. Revenue rose from RM221.8m in FY2023 to RM266.0m in FY2024, with profit after tax of RM16.8m (6.3% margin) versus a FY2023 loss of RM7.4m. Operating cash flow was RM24.0m in FY2024 (FY2023: RM3.1m), and free cash flow turned positive at RM9.8m. Interest coverage improved to 8.59x from -2.06x. Leverage rose to 1.20 from 1.04, and receivables remain slow at 92.6 days.

The record lists no litigation cases. The main evidence gap is the absence of FY2025 financials; the snapshot is 31 December 2025, so the latest reported year is over 18 months old. Follow-up: request FY2025 audited accounts to confirm the FY2024 profitability and cash-flow recovery has held.

Teguh Bestari Medical Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in 1988, based in Sabah, providing dental clinic and orthodontic services. Its latest filed accounts are FY2024 (year-end 31 December 2024), audited unqualified by Audit Firm 7. Revenue was RM1,160,005, up from RM1,090,307 in FY2023, but gross margin slipped from 46.3% to 42.5% as cost of sales rose. Operating profit held at RM144,500 (12.5% margin) and profit after tax was RM90,125. Operating cash flow of RM168,772 comfortably funded capital expenditure of RM24,175, leaving free cash flow of RM144,597. Leverage eased to 0.93 and interest cover was 5.58x, though the quick ratio fell to 1.07 and cash dropped to RM59,334 from RM133,552.

Ownership is concentrated: Director 1 holds 63.91% and is Managing Director; Director 2 holds 36.09% and is also a director, so full director-shareholder overlap exists.

Litigation is material. The company is defendant in a Sabah Sessions Court tenancy dispute (CASE-2025-9161, filed August 2025) with judgment entered and RM310,600 claimed. It is plaintiff in several debt-recovery and contract cases, including a pending RM39,400 claim and judgments entered for RM26,100 and RM2,512,900; one RM1,077,100 claim was withdrawn and a RM1,269,100 claim dismissed. Claim amounts are amounts sought, not findings.

Follow-up: obtain the judgment terms and any payment or provision relating to CASE-2025-9161, given the RM310,600 exposure against FY2024 cash of RM59,334.

Mega Mutiara Catering Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in 1990, based in Pulau Pinang, producing bread and cakes for retail shops. The record lists no litigation cases.

Financially, the latest available year is FY2024 (year-end 31 December 2024). Revenue was RM32.08 million, down from RM34.22 million in FY2023 and RM36.02 million in FY2022. The company has recorded operating losses across all three years: operating profit of -RM4.03 million in FY2024, widening from -RM2.82 million in FY2023 and -RM1.96 million in FY2022. Profit after tax was -RM4.47 million in FY2024, with total equity falling to RM20.05 million from RM24.52 million in FY2023. Operating cash flow was negative at -RM4.46 million in FY2024, and free cash flow was -RM5.12 million. Interest coverage was -9.15 times in FY2024, indicating earnings do not cover interest expense of RM440,520. Leverage rose to 1.47.

Ownership is concentrated: Director 3 holds 54.63%, Director 1 holds 23.47% and Director 4 holds 21.9%, all individual shareholders who are also directors. Audits for FY2022–FY2024 were unqualified by Audit Firm 1.

Follow-up: request the FY2025 management accounts and an explanation of the sustained operating losses and negative operating cash flow.

**Indah Bestari Hotel Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000674) is an active private limited company incorporated 8 July 2018 in Selangor, operating a boutique hotel in the Klang Valley. Share capital is RM250,000. Ownership is concentrated: Director 1 holds 66.06%, Director 3 19.39% and Director 2 14.55% — all three shareholders are also directors, so ownership and management overlap fully.

Financials are available to FY2024 (year-end 31 March 2024), all with unqualified opinions from Audit Firm 1. Revenue rose from RM35.83m (FY2022) to RM38.80m (FY2024), but gross margin fell from 65.01% to 56.65% and net margin from 7.23% to 6.41%; FY2024 profit after tax was RM2.49m. Leverage is modest (0.281) and interest coverage comfortable at 14.24x. Liquidity weakened: quick ratio 2.65 and cash ratio 0.58 at FY2024, down from 3.41 and 1.20 at FY2023, with the cash conversion cycle lengthening to 101.4 days.

The record lists two debt-recovery cases where the company is plaintiff: CASE-2025-2955 (High Court, RM1,363,700 claim, settled) and CASE-2021-0079 (Sessions Court, RM704,300 claim, withdrawn). No defendant cases are recorded.

Follow-up: obtain FY2025 audited accounts to confirm whether the margin compression and cash-ratio decline continued.

**Mega Murni Klinik Sdn. Bhd.** (SYN-000677) is an active private limited company incorporated in December 1996, based in Selangor, providing home nursing care for the elderly. Issued share capital is RM500,000.

**Ownership and governance.** All four shareholders are individuals who also serve as directors: Director 1 (37.75%), Director 2 (28.55%), Director 3 (22.28%) and Director 5 (11.42%). Director 4 is an independent director with no recorded shareholding. This is a closely held, owner-managed structure with full director-shareholder overlap among the four holders — a concentration that limits external oversight.

**Financials.** FY2024 (year-end 30 September 2024) shows revenue of RM16.94m, up from RM12.21m in FY2023 and RM9.09m in FY2022. Gross margin improved to 48.85% (FY2023: 45.48%); net margin 9.64% (6.79%). Operating cash flow was RM2.33m and free cash flow RM1.63m. Leverage rose to 2.03 (FY2023: 1.70), with borrowings of RM7.21m against equity of RM6.00m; interest coverage improved to 6.42x. The cash conversion cycle lengthened to 173 days, driven by receivables at 95.9 days and inventory at 100.2 days. Audit opinions were unqualified across FY2022–FY2024.

**Litigation.** The record lists five cases, all as plaintiff. One is pending: CASE-2025-2755 (debt recovery, Sessions Court Selangor, filed 14 August 2025, RM211,500 claimed). Others are settled, dismissed or withdrawn.

**Follow-up:** Request the FY2025 audited accounts, since the latest financials end 30 September 2024 and predate the snapshot.

**Seri Everbright Klinik Sdn. Bhd.** is an active private limited company incorporated in December 1995, based in Kedah, providing home elderly care services. Paid-up share capital is RM5,000,000.

**Financials (FY2024, year-end 31 Dec 2024):** Revenue RM57.99m, gross profit RM27.30m (47.1% margin), operating profit RM5.50m (9.5%), profit after tax RM3.85m (6.6%). Operating cash flow RM6.12m; free cash flow RM3.88m. Total assets RM68.97m, total liabilities RM29.46m, equity RM39.51m. Interest coverage 12.8x and debt service coverage 5.1x.
